artworks.title: Death of Cleopatra
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying in a reclined position on their side. Their upper body is propped up slightly by their left arm, while their right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand resting on their chest. The individual has rounded facial features and their hair is covered by a cloth. The person is not wearing clothing. A tree is partially visible in the background. The individual is holding a small round object. The background shows a landscape with a town or village, buildings, winding streets, hills, and trees. The scene is depicted in an etching style, highlighting the contours and shading.

artworks.title: Map of Vienna
artworks.medium: etching with hand coloring on laid paper [made up of 6 parts mounted on cloth and folded]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old city map. The map depicts an aerial view of a walled city with a network of streets and various buildings, surrounded by fortifications and a water body. The walls have bastions and gates along the perimeter. The map is bordered with decorative elements such as compasses, emblems, and illustrated scrollwork in each corner. The detailed drawing suggests attention to geographical features, city layout, and adornments, making it both a functional map and an art piece.

artworks.title: The Creation of Eve
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene in a natural setting with celestial elements. The image shows a crowned figure with a radiant aura kneeling beside a reclining, unclothed figure. Surrounding this scene are various animals, including birds, a dog, and grazing creatures, with a backdrop of trees. The sky above is filled with clouds, stars, celestial faces, beams of light, the sun, and the moon amidst swirling clouds. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer, known for intricate woodcuts and detailed engravings featuring nature, human form, and celestial bodies.

artworks.title: The Emperor
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne, wearing regal clothing. They are holding a scepter and being crowned by a skeleton. Other figures surround the throne, wearing intricate garments typical of a royal court setting. Various regal items, such as a crown and an hourglass, are placed around the throne. The background is decorated with drapery and architectural details.

artworks.title: The Cardinal
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in historical attire engaged in conversation. One figure is seated on the left wearing a large brimmed hat and long robes, holding a document. The other figure stands on the right with a sword and a bag slung over their shoulder. The image shows detailed fabric, line work, and decorative elements like vinery in the background. The style resembles works by Albrecht Dürer with meticulous attention to detail and intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Bishop
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a bishop dancing with a skeletal figure representing Death. The bishop holds a crozier and has a stern expression. In the background, there are other figures including a shepherd and a person with raised arms. The scene is set in a pastoral landscape with hills, trees, and a castle in the distance. A sun shines in the sky with two birds flying above. An hourglass is placed next to the bishop and Death.

artworks.title: The Duke
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure interacting with other elaborately dressed figures. The skeletal figure is reaching towards a person clad in a detailed cloak. Other figures appear in the scene, with one in a hooded garment possibly gesturing defensively. The setting is an outdoor one, with a distant view of mountains or hills in the background. The overall black line work and shading create a historical and dramatic atmosphere, focusing on contrasting life and death motifs.

artworks.title: The Abbess
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure leading two hooded figures. The image depicts a skeletal figure leading two figures dressed in long, flowing robes. The skeletal figure appears with an exaggerated, bony structure and decorative elements on its head. One robed figure holds a rosary or string of beads, while both figures have their mouths slightly open. The second robed figure raises an arm in a gesture, and the setting is outside a large, arching doorway with a bell hanging above. The style resembles medieval woodcuts, emphasizing line and contrast.

artworks.title: The Councillor
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a scene with a skeleton, an executioner, and three men. The style resembles a woodcut, showing contrast and line detailing. The skeleton holds an hourglass, symbolizing time passing. In the foreground, a richly dressed man puts a hat on another man. An executioner stands nearby with a weapon. A demon or bat-like creature hovers above. The background includes architectural elements and an overcast sky.

artworks.title: The Parish Priest
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a procession scene involving a skeletal figure and two other individuals. The skeletal figure is dressed in tattered clothing and carrying a lantern, leading the procession with another individual wearing ornate robes and a flat cap. A smaller figure with a satchel or pot follows closely behind. The background shows a detailed medieval-style architectural setting with brick buildings, arched windows, and smoky clouds near chimney tops. The drawing is highly detailed with sharp lines and contrasts typical of woodcut prints.

artworks.title: The Mendicant Friar
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton interacting with a surprised individual amidst an architectural and cloud-filled backdrop. The scene is rendered in a detailed monochromatic style, utilizing intricate line work to convey texture and form. In the foreground, a robed figure is pulling away from a lively skeleton that holds onto the cloak with one hand. The skeleton appears animated and expressive. To the left, an ornately decorated column anchors the scene, and an hourglass can be seen on the ground. Swirling clouds dominate the background, adding a sense of movement and drama to the composition.

artworks.title: The Physician
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton interacting with two figures in an interior setting. The drawing depicts a scene where a skeleton holds a flask. One cloaked figure sits at a table, looking at the skeleton. Another figure with a cane stands behind the skeleton. A small animal lies on the floor. The setting includes various objects like books and vessels on a shelf. The artwork portrays a theme of mortality and knowledge.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: graphite on parchment, with black ink and green watercolor in a decorative border
artworks.dimensions:
image (diameter): 9 cm (3 9/16 in.)
sheet (diameter): 13.8 cm (5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome drawing of a man's bust. He is facing to his left with a distinctive nose and chin, and has wavy, powder-white hair tied back. The man is dressed in a high-collared shirt with a ruffled cravat and a coat typical of 18th-century formal attire. The background is plain with a circular frame around the subject, emphasizing his features and clothing.

artworks.title: Ferdinand I
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.7 x 27.2 cm (14 1/16 x 10 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait with a man in the center of an ornate frame. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to one side. The man has distinctive facial features with a beard and mustache. He wears a beret-style hat and elaborate Renaissance clothing with a fur collar and embroidered sleeves. He holds a paper or scroll in his hand. The frame is decorated with a heraldic shield at the top and two allegorical figures on each side of him. The background features a detailed cityscape with buildings and a steeple in the distance.

artworks.title: Nude
artworks.description: The image is a partial sketch of a nude figure, depicting the body from the top of the head down to the thighs. The person's position is mostly upright, with one arm bent at the elbow and the hand placed on the hip, while the other arm, though partially visible, is positioned downward and to the side. The facial features are not defined, and there is also no hair detail visible in the sketch. There is no clothing present as the figure is rendered in a nude study, and the focus is on the contours and shading of the body. The background is a plain, light color.

artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals on a beach. The drawing showcases several figures engaging in activities by the shoreline. In the foreground, two figures are depicted holding up towels or pieces of cloth. The figures have an exaggerated, slightly distorted style with intricate line work, especially evident in the rendering of the water and sky. The background includes others enjoying the water, with waves lapping at the shore.

artworks.title: Animal Legend (Tierlegende)
artworks.description: The image displays a composition of sharp, angular shapes and curved, flowing lines converging in a striking manner. It is an abstract design where the conglomeration of lines and shapes suggest familiar objects like animals situated among foliage. The bold, dark lines against a pale background accentuate what seems like a leaping antelope, small creatures resembling rodents, and abstract formations that evoke a natural setting or landscape.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher on Horseback
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.4 × 20.3 cm (11 3/16 × 8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man riding a horse. He is seated sideways on the horse with his body turned slightly to face forward, holding the reins in one hand while the other holds a large staff with a forked end. The man has a long, flowing beard and hair, wearing a cap and a voluminous garment with intricate folds. He appears to have a focused and intense expression on his face, looking upwards. On his back, there is a large cloth or cloak billowing dramatically in the wind. Behind him, a smaller figure holds a sphere and a cross. The horse is richly adorned with decorative tack and is stepping forward over a rocky path. In the background, a small figure appears to follow or observe from behind a rock, holding a lantern. The scene is set in an outdoor landscape featuring sparse, stylized trees and rocky terrain, with a building or castle in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Faun Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.6 x 21.7 cm (10 7/8 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with figures and animals in a natural setting. The drawing depicts a detailed landscape with trees, foliage, and a riverbank. In the foreground, three figures are seated under a tree surrounded by animals including a dog and what appears to be a rabbit. The background features a church steeple and other architectural elements.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory
artworks.medium: engraving on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This print depicts a scene inside a church with a gathering around an altar. In the center of the print, a man sits, emerging from a hollow structure on top of the altar. The man is bare chested, with long flowing hair and a halo around his head. He looks down, his head turned to the left and his hands on top of one another. He has a wound on his chest and one on the back of his visible hand. Behind him is a large cross, which stands in front of several tall panels decorated with scenes of conflict and battle. There are two tall candles on either side of him, and an open book and a chalice are in front of him. A large group of people is gathered around the sides of the altar, with three men in the front kneeling in front of it. These men all wear robes and are bald on the tops of their heads. The architecture of the church features pointed arches in the ceiling with ribbed vaults. The floor below the gathered group is a grid of small squares. There is a small line of text at the bottom of the print, and the background is beige paper.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman and a baby. The woman is shown in a partial profile view with her head turned slightly towards the viewer. Her facial features are outlined, including a long nose, pronounced lips, and deeply set eyes. Her long flowing hair is visible. The baby, held closely to the woman, is facing the viewer with round eyes and delicate features. The woman's arms and slender fingers holding the baby are visible. There are no clothing details in the sketch. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Paysage avec berger et moutons a Osny (Pontoise)
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a winding path leading towards a group of bare trees. Among the trees, a figure tends to a flock of sheep. The horizon is low, and the landscape is undulating, creating a sense of depth. The brushstrokes are sketch-like and the color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and muted tones.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sportsman and Dog
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the middle, featuring mountains, a village with a church spire, a pathway with a figure and an animal, delicate etchings of reeds and grass, a tall tree, and birds. The artwork is created with fine lines and cross-hatching, using a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: View over the Amstel from the Rampart
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
